items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: "He used to play with a little fella that's called Clayton. I forget that boy's name."

ctx.x: I think it was the Tuxedo Band, I believe. Mm-hmm. Did you ever play at the Tuxedo Grass Band or... Not in them days, no. The Onward Grass Band, Emmanuel Perez, ever? No, I didn't play with them. I might ask, we only have another minute or so on this tape, but who were your favorite trombonists? You mentioned Frankie Doosen and any others that you liked real well?

Yeah, I got a couple of young fellas under them, a little fella by the name of Moise French. Used to play with Rene. I've heard of him, I never heard of him. Yeah, I find he was a sweet little trombone player. We had another little fella that you played some nice trombone. He used to play with a little fella that's called Clayton. I forget that boy's name. Did you ever interview Clayton? No, not yet.
We'll do that pretty soon. Yeah, well... I know him very well.
